}}'''Meilan Mendiana''' was a [[High Lord]] of [[Tear]].{{ref|{{twotc}}, Meilan Mendiana}} 

== Appearance ==
He has gray hair with dark eyes. He is tall, lean and hard.

== Activities ==
He attends a meeting with [[Rand al'Thor]] along with High Lords [[Tedosian]], [[Carleon]] and [[Sunamon]] after Rand captures the [[Stone of Tear]].{{ref/book|4|8}} He, along with Sunamon, presented Rand with their proposed treaty with [[Mayene]] to distribute Tear's excess grain, whilst also allowing the presence of two thousand Tairen soldiers under [[Torean]]'s command. Rand burns the proposal and commands them to offer [[Berelain]] a fair treaty directly or be hanged.{{ref/book|4|9}}

When Rand leaves Tear, Meilan is one of the High Lords sent to [[Cairhien]] to lead an army there and distribute grain.{{ref/book|4|21}}

When the [[Shaido]] attack Cairhien Meilan is in overall charge of the defenses. He swears fealty to Rand after Rand captures Cairhien and defeats the Shaido.

His ambition is to take the [[Sun Throne]] for himself. He meets with [[Nesune Bihara]] over plotting for the Throne. 
He is assassinated in the street at [[Colavaere Saighan]]'s orders who wants the Sun Throne for herself.

== Viewing ==
[[Min's viewings]] shows he will die by the knife. ''(fulfilled)''
